worker_output.summary: Implemented population growth system with logistic growth, environment/racial/morale modifiers, cloning tech, max population calculation. 42 tests added. 266/266 tests pass, typecheck clean.

verification_result.notes: All acceptance criteria met. Logistic growth formula correct. Environment modifiers implemented as lookup maps (no if/else chains). Racial bonuses correct: Rabbits 2×, Hermit Crabs ignore env (both growth and capacity), Ants +25% capacity and morale=1.0, Mice food_per_colonist=0.5. All 3 worked examples from design doc verified in tests (Example 1: growth=2/frac=0.1, Example 2: growth=9/frac≈0.418, Example 3: growth=0/frac=0.778, Example 4: 21 starvation deaths). Difficulty modifiers all 5 levels correct. Fractional carry-over accumulation tested. No DOM imports in src/game/. No `any` types. 42 new tests, 266/266 total passing.
